title: The Damp coat in the hall
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：damp　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 damp 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the driver wrote of ① a damp coat in the hall in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② damper than the one named there the year before. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it with great care and gone home; it was the damp ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the dampest coat in the hall anybody in the station had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1960 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too damp to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the damp ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a damp cellar under the shop, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as damp as the cellar under the shop they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was damp or not, and he said so.

By 1973 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something damp, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite damp; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the damp ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1976, on the same day, she wrote of another damp coat in the hall in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ damper than anybody had expected. ⑩ The dampest cellar under the shop in the whole station, she said in 1978, was the one she could never quite name; the damp ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 潮湿（前置定语 a damp coat in the hall：1966 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件潮湿的外套）
B. adj. 潮湿／潮乎乎（比较级 damper than：文中两处，一处比厅里的外套，一处比预想）
C. adj. 潮湿／潮乎乎（最高级 the dampest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 潮湿（表语 too damp to do：母亲觉得它太潮湿，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 潮乎乎（前置定语 a damp cellar under the shop：叔叔把整件事称作一桩潮乎乎的地窖）
F. adj. 潮乎乎（同级比较 as damp as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩店下的地窖相比）
G. adj. 潮乎乎（后置定语 something damp：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 潮乎乎（受程度副词修饰 quite damp：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a damp coat in the hall
the dampest coat in the hall anybody
a damp cellar under the shop
The dampest cellar under the shop in

answers.why: damp 意为“潮湿”，1966 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件潮湿的外套”，此处作前置定语 a damp coat in the hall。
damp 意为“潮湿”，此处用比较级 damper than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
damp 意为“潮湿”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说它是车站里最潮湿的一件，故用最高级 the dampest coat in the hall。
damp 意为“潮湿”，母亲认为这件东西“太潮湿了，谁也用不上”，too damp to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
damp 意为“潮乎乎”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩潮乎乎的地窖”，此处作前置定语 a damp cellar under the shop。
damp 意为“潮乎乎”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩店下的地窖一样潮乎乎”，同级比较用 as damp as。
damp 意为“潮乎乎”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“潮乎乎的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something damp。
damp 意为“潮乎乎”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当潮乎乎”，quite 修饰原级 damp。
damp 意为“潮乎乎”，1976 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要潮乎乎”，故用比较级 damper than。
damp 意为“潮乎乎”，母亲 1978 年说的是“整个车站里最潮乎乎的那一桩”，故用最高级 the dampest cellar under the shop。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1966 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件潮湿的外套。（a damp coat in the hall）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更潮湿。（damper than …）
母亲觉得它太潮湿，谁也用不上。（too damp to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩潮乎乎的地窖。（a damp cellar under the shop）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩店下的地窖一样潮乎乎。（as damp as …）
到了 1973 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件潮乎乎的东西。（something damp）
answers: In 1966 the driver wrote of a damp coat in the hall in the timetable.
Everybody said it was damper than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too damp to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a damp cellar under the shop.
He said nobody would call it as damp as the cellar under the shop they had once had.
By 1973 the timetable asked for nothing but something damp.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 damp 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1966 the driver wrote of a damp coat in the hall in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the dampest coat in the hall in the station, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too damp to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a damp cellar under the shop, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite damp, and everybody laughed.
The damp ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
